USE USOnTimeProject;

--Table 1 - Airport

IF OBJECT_ID('gold.Airport') IS NOT NULL
    DROP EXTERNAL TABLE gold.Airport
GO

CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE gold.Airport
    WITH
    (
        DATA_SOURCE = USOnTimeProject_RootFS,
        LOCATION = 'Gold/Lookup/Airport',
        FILE_FORMAT = parquet_file_format
    )
AS
SELECT *
  FROM silver.Airport;

  SELECT *
  FROM gold.Airport;
